patch_reason: Original CSI parsing writes beyond fixed16-argument array for a long semicolon sequence. Overlong CSI now enters discard-until-final state.
Saturate CSI/OSC numeric parameters below31-bit reserved flag/missing bits, avoiding signed Windows long overflow.
Avoid null-pointer subtraction and fragment dispatch before an OSC/DCS string body starts.
Ignore REP before a printable glyph: its zero-width repeat loop otherwise never advances.
Bound retained combining characters across chunks to the screen cell capacity instead of unbounded buffer growth.
validation_scope: Targeted native regression coverage; not a complete security proof or exhaustive standards conformance audit.
runtime: C99 compiled into static ade_vterm library; no external DLL or interpreter
